title: 'The Lost Sentry' quest asks you to put down a moor-wight on the Wardmoor moor. Explored 8 distinct moor tiles (Moor Road, Cairn Field, Twin Ruts, Peat Score, Long Sight, Windbreak Stones, Last Cairn, Tower Rise/signal tower) and never encountered it. Corporal Fenn's hint ('you'll hear them before you see them in a mist') implies a time/weather trigger the game gives no way to check or force.
where: Wardmoor moor / 'The Lost Sentry' quest (Sergeant Rook, Highward parade ground)
